notes: The %AdjKM macro (verbatim from AdjKM_SAS_Macro.sas) computes adjusted Kaplan-Meier curves for partly-unobserved binary group membership. The repo ships only the macro definition and a .sas7bdat example; this bundle adds a small caller with 50 rows of inline synthetic survival data (columns binary_time/time/event, matching the README's example call) exercising all three donor branches (donor identified, no donor, donor-search ceased). Invoked as %AdjKM(work.simbsp, binary_time, time, event, tsearch=5, tstar=5, atrisk=(empty), alpha=0.05, boot_method=NO, boot_rep=0, ...) so the run is fast and deterministic. Produces the observed-vs-expected donor tabulate, the weighted KM estimates by group (PROC LIFETEST), and the survival-probability listing.
